claim: The first draft treated lighting as the settled cause; it is a hypothesis.
uncertainty: This is a hypothesis; no test has been run in the synthetic data.
assumptions: I assume the survey sample is comparable across quarters.
hypothesis: Lighting may contribute to perceived safety (hypothesis).
mechanism: Visibility changes how safe people feel, not necessarily the incident counts.
test_that_would_disprove_it: If lit and unlit areas show equal unsafe shares, drop the hypothesis.
